newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch oilseed crush up in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Dutch oilseed crush up in first quarter.

text.p: Dutch oilseed firms crushed 1.25 million tonnes of seed in the first quarter of 1997, 60,000 tonnes or 5.1 percent more than in the same period last year, the Dutch Oils and Fats Board (MVO) said on Monday.
The soy crush rose 37,000 tonnes, 3.8 percent, to 1.02 million tonnes.

Processing of sunflowerseed rose 20,000 tonnes to 168,000 and some 44,000 tonnes of rapeseed was crushed, almost 50 percent up on 1996, when high prices for rapeseed dented the crush figure. Linseed processing dropped 9,000 tonnes to 15,000.
